setting.name: Fixed worker pool
setting.description: Calculate workers from a fixed percentage of plebeian population instead of their ages.

setting.name: Fixed worker pool percentage
setting.description: Percentage of plebeian population available for work when Fixed worker pool is enabled, before employment blessings.

setting.name: Enemy retreat speed multiplier
setting.description: Movement speed while invading enemies retreat: 1 is normal speed, 2 is double speed.

setting.name: Defenses block wildlife
setting.description: Recheck animal movement when defenses are built across a route. Disable to reproduce the original traversal behavior.

setting.name: Rioters attack fireproof defenses
setting.description: Allow rioters to destroy gatehouses, palisades and palisade gates even when they are fireproof.

setting.name: Wandering citizens
setting.description: Optional ambient citizens while global labour is enabled. Independent of the existing unemployment-driven beggars.

setting.name: Dogs
setting.description: Ambient dogs roam from occupied houses.
